review_method: Fresh visual inspection of the newly acquired original map pixels, its cartographic credits, the successful original acquisition receipt and the official discovery page. Every selected source and baseline-rendered polygon part and ring was viewed in full. Ordered positions, bounds and ring closure were independently recomputed from the retained source collection and selected decoded baseline. Regional relative position, orientation, outline and nearby separately labelled waters were considered together; neither bounds nor label overlap alone established identity. The packed decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer. Independent observations were recorded before comparing the source researcher’s draft.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.
